purpose: Teach: 役職/折衝/統括/取り寄せ/開演/切り上げ/一段落/振り回さ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.en: It's time we reviewed the position structure.
lines.style: Direct, measured opening. Brief pause after the statement—not waiting for response, just letting the weight land. Composed authority without harshness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。海外との折衝、慎重に進めています。
lines.en: Yes. We're moving forward carefully with the overseas negotiations.
lines.style: Steady, professional acknowledgment. Slight emphasis on 'carefully'—not defensive, but showing he's taking the charge seriously. Even tempo, respectful distance in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 統括部長、引き続き任せる。
lines.en: I'm keeping you as group manager. Continue as you are.
lines.style: Calm affirmation with quiet confidence. No inflation—just clear conviction delivered flatly. The kind of reassurance that comes from having already made up his mind.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 部品、海外から取り寄せ済みです。
lines.en: The parts have already been sourced from overseas.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact status report. Crisp delivery on the opening—showing initiative. No flourish, just facts in sequence. Businesslike efficiency.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 発表会、開演時間、急ぎ案内しろ。
lines.en: For the launch event—get the opening time confirmed and communicated right away.
lines.style: Sharp, urgent request delivered without edge. Forward momentum in the phrasing. Expectation of quick action, not panic.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。会議、夕方、切り上げます。
lines.en: Understood. I'll wrap up the meeting by evening.
lines.style: Quick affirmation—no hesitation. Clipped, efficient. Shows he's already calculating how to make it happen. Lean, focused delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: プロジェクト、一段落するのは、来月か。
lines.en: So we're looking at next month before this phase winds down?
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly distant tone. Not quite a question, more a musing aloud—testing the timeline with gentle skepticism. Pace slows fractionally at the end.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。客先に振り回されない、しっかりした計画、出します。
lines.en: Yes. I'll put together a solid plan that doesn't let the client push us around.
lines.style: Quiet conviction underlying the words. Slight firm edge on 'solid'—not aggressive, but showing backbone. Ends with steady resolve, no apology in the tone.
